title: Correction into a value already remembered, re-confirmation and background restatement (MEM-AR-01C, D-1)
purpose: Records that a correction into a value already remembered keeps that Memory (CORRECTED_TO_EXISTING) instead of a second ACTIVE copy, that an explicit remember of a fact already kept is ALREADY_REMEMBERED, and that a background restatement of it writes nothing (EQUIVALENT_EXISTS).

steps.note: a second residence captured beside it

steps.text: أنا مش ساكن في أكتوبر دلوقتي، أنا ساكن في طنطا
steps.note: the new value already exists: CORRECTED_TO_EXISTING, one ACTIVE «طنطا»
an ordinary restatement: the background writes nothing
